pos.personaBrief: Conte's Juventus and Italy had plenty of the ball (SI, Spielverlagerung) but the aim was danger and balance, not possession for its own sake; he says he wants balance, not to reduce offensively.

pro.personaBrief: Juventus used the patient 'diamond at the back' build-up (SoccerTutor), while Italy and Chelsea sought deep passes to the strikers and fast transitions.

est.personaBrief: His 3-5-2 has rehearsed, defined roles per phase (SoccerTutor, drilled transitions), with wing-backs holding width and strikers dropping to link.

lar.personaBrief: Wing-backs pushing high and wide, crosses for Llorente, Pelle and Lukaku, but no true wingers in the 3-5-2.

blo.personaBrief: Forwards pressed aggressively and Italy pressed Spain high; Juventus had a higher press (SoccerTutor, SI, Spielverlagerung).

mar.personaBrief: Italy used a rigid man-marking scheme at Euro 2016 and Juventus used man-oriented chain-reaction marking.

pla.personaBrief: Conte tailors the plan to the opponent (Spain 2016, Arsenal switch to 3-4-3 at half-time) while imposing his own model on arrival.

res.personaBrief: A winner-first, pragmatic coach with back-five solidity, focused on balance and titles.

sis.personaBrief: Heavily drilled systems, everyone has a tactical job, ruthless with those who don't fit (Icardi, Terry, Costa).

jog.personaBrief: Intensity, physical presence and stamina for wing-backs and strikers like Lukaku, Kante and Moses.

bas.personaBrief: Prefers experienced title-winners (Inter signings), though he spoke of lowering age at Chelsea and building foundations at Napoli.

lid.personaBrief: Authoritarian and frank, ruthless with stars (Terry, Costa, Icardi), rules for everyone.
